description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of FOCUS values across four political leanings—Left bias, Left center bias, Quest. source, and Right bias—categorized by narrative roles: HERO (blue), VICTIM (brown), and VILLAIN (light blue). Each vertical bar represents a political leaning, with the segments showing the proportion of FOCUS values assigned to each role. The y-axis represents the proportion of FOCUS values, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, while the x-axis lists the political leanings. In the Left bias category, the HERO role accounts for approximately 0.38 of the FOCUS, VICTIM for about 0.12, and VILLAIN for roughly 0.50. For Left center bias, HERO is around 0.40, VICTIM is about 0.18, and VILLAIN is approximately 0.42. In the Quest. source category, HERO makes up about 0.50, VICTIM is around 0.05, and VILLAIN is approximately 0.45. For Right bias, HERO is about 0.30, VICTIM is approximately 0.10, and VILLAIN is around 0.60. The legend indicates that HERO is represented by blue, VICTIM by brown, and VILLAIN by light blue. The chart shows that the VILLAIN role has the highest proportion in all categories except Quest. source, where HERO is the highest.
